kind: analyze (64-site oxygen environment table, nine-class occupancy, relaxation displacements of the doped and the undoped supercell, first/second cation-shell separation, relaxed undoped space group)
provenance: 3_reproduction/L1/ (reproduced 2026-09-05, commit f970360): environments.csv (guards G3/G4) and result.json metrics M1, M2, M3 and guard G1, re-derived by reviewer/make_reference_submission.py on 2026-09-10 from the four staged structures by an independent route (periodic distance matrix, minimum-image displacements, spglib) and asserted equal to the leaf's artifacts.

site_environments.rule: 64 rows; each matched to one distinct oxygen of agent/ideal_x050.vasp within 0.25 A (the nearest O-O distance in the ideal cell is 2.51 A, so matching is unambiguous well beyond a two-decimal table, whose worst rounding error is 0.063 A); (n_Hf, n_Zr) exact (rule 2(4)). The classification is re-run by the grader on the staged ideal cell (envclass.py, 2.3 A).

longest_bond_A.rule: absolute 0.01 A (rule 2(5) exception: a geometry read-off from a fixed structure; a relative band would be wider than the bond-length spread and stop discriminating); result.json M3 relaxed_cell.longest_included

closest_nonbonded_cation_A.rule: absolute 0.01 A (same exception); result.json M3 relaxed_cell.shortest_excluded

space_group_number_undoped_relaxed.rule: exact int (rule 2(4)); result.json guard G1 (Pca2_1 at symprec 1e-3)

not_graded.per_species_displacements: result.json M2 per-species maxima are a recorded breakdown, not requested
not_graded.ideal_cell_shell_gap: M3 on the ideal cell (2.2313 / 3.2575 A) is not requested; the relaxed cell is the graded one
not_graded.label_survival: G3 (identical labels on the relaxed coordinates) is a self-reported consistency metric and is not asked for (pure-guesser hole)

score: 1 only if every primary check passes (binary all-primary-pass)
